info.title: Training Institute Management API
info.description: REST API backed by JSON-file storage. All responses use { success, data, meta? } or { success:false, error:{ code, message, details? } }. Full examples: docs/api-examples.md

post.summary: Revoke the current access token (role: any)
Issue a reset token (dev: written to data/outbox.json)
Change password (signs out other sessions) (role: any)

get.summary: List courses (q, category, level, mode, sort, page, limit; admin: all=true)
Course by id or slug, incl. trainer + batches

delete.summary: Archive course (?hard=true to delete when unused) (role: admin)
Deactivate trainer (?hard=true to delete when unused) (role: admin)

get.summary: Appointment detail (owner, admin or assigned trainer) (role: any)
Filter appointments (status, trainerId, courseId, date, from, to, q, hasRequest) (role: admin)
List students (q, status, page, limit) (role: admin)
Student detail with enrollments and appointments (role: admin)

post.summary: Submit a course review (requires enrollment) (role: student)
